verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an AI inference platform, and a platform like this could plausibly offer automations or pipelines, so the axis applies. The evidence documents no automation feature that can be versioned, reviewed or rolled back. Request-level model version pinning ("MODEL_NAME:VERSION") and the model deprecation policy cover model lifecycle, not the user's automations, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
